name: fshare-repo
description: fshare monorepo: laptop CLI (cli/) and phone app (mobile/)

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix cli && npm ci --prefix mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix cli && npm run typecheck --prefix mobile
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm test --prefix cli && npm test --prefix mobile
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
